concepts.title: Tensor equivalence
concepts.description: A strong monoidal functor whose underlying functor is an equivalence of categories.

concepts.title: Strong monoidal functor
concepts.description: A functor equipped with coherent isomorphisms preserving tensor products and the tensor unit.

concepts.title: Monoidal natural transformation
concepts.description: A natural transformation between strong monoidal functors compatible with their tensor-product and unit isomorphisms.

concepts.title: Natural isomorphism
concepts.description: A natural transformation whose component at every object is an isomorphism.

concepts.title: Natural transformation
concepts.description: A family of maps between the values of two functors, commuting with every morphism in their source category.

concepts.title: Product of categories
concepts.description: C×D has pairs of objects and pairs of morphisms, with identities and composition defined componentwise.

concepts.title: Quotient of a linear category by an ideal
concepts.description: For a k-linear category C and a linear ideal I closed under composition on either side, C/I has the same objects and morphism spaces Hom_C(X,Y)/I(X,Y), with induced composition.

concepts.title: Representable functor
concepts.description: A functor naturally isomorphic to Hom(A,−), or to Hom(−,A) in the contravariant case.

concepts.title: Subobject in a category
concepts.description: An equivalence class of monomorphisms into a fixed object, where two are equivalent if an isomorphism of their domains commutes with the maps.

concepts.title: Zero object in a category
concepts.description: An object 0 of a category such that for every object X there is exactly one morphism 0→X and exactly one morphism X→0.

concepts.title: Rational forms pass to Drinfeld centers
concepts.description: In the characteristic-zero fusion-category setting, if C_k is a rational form of C_K, the natural functor Z(C_k)⊗_k K→Z(C_K) is fully faithful, dominant, and commutes with induction. Thus Z(C_k) is a braided rational form, with idempotent completion understood.

concepts.title: Induction to the Drinfeld center of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category C over ℂ, the induction functor I:C→Z(C) is the left adjoint to the functor forgetting the half-braiding. Its underlying object is ⊕_V V⊗X⊗V*, summed over simple representatives V.

concepts.title: Dual fusion category
concepts.description: For an indecomposable semisimple module category M over a fusion category C, the category Fun_C(M,M) of module endofunctors, with composition as tensor product.

concepts.title: Half-braiding
concepts.description: For an object X of a monoidal category C, a natural family of isomorphisms c_Y:X⊗Y→Y⊗X, compatible with tensor products and the unit: c_{Y⊗Z}=(id_Y⊗c_Z)∘(c_Y⊗id_Z), with associators inserted.

concepts.title: Internal Hom in a module category
concepts.description: For objects M,N of a module category over C, an internal Hom is an object [M,N] of C with natural bijections Hom_C(X,[M,N])≅Hom_M(X⊗M,N). It exists in the finite semisimple setting used here.

concepts.title: Modular tensor category
concepts.description: A ribbon fusion category over ℂ whose S-matrix is invertible.

concepts.title: Module category over a tensor category
concepts.description: A category M with an action C×M→M and coherent associativity and unit isomorphisms.

concepts.title: Rational forms pass to dual fusion categories
concepts.description: In the characteristic-zero fusion-category setting, let M_K be an indecomposable finite semisimple module category over D_K and let D_k,M_k be compatible rational forms. Scalar extension induces a fully faithful dominant functor Fun_{D_k}(M_k,M_k)⊗_k K→Fun_{D_K}(M_K,M_K), so the dual category over k is a rational form of the dual over K.
